        beam = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, y, width=beam_w, height=beam_h, angle=0, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(beam, restitution=0.05)
        sandbox.set_damping(beam, linear=0.5, angular=0.5)
        left_beams.append(beam)

    # Middle Strip - 1 mandatory beam
    middle_y = 3.5
    middle_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x_middle, middle_y, width=beam_w, height=beam_h, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(middle_beam, restitution=0.05)

    right_beams = [

        sandbox.add_beam(x_right, 7.0, width=beam_w, height=beam_h, angle=0, density=density)
    ]
    for beam in right_beams:
        sandbox.set_material_properties(beam, restitution=0.05)
        sandbox.set_damping(beam, linear=0.5, angular=0.5)

    # Connect Left Beams Vertically
    for i in range(len(left_beams) - 1):

    # Connect Middle Beam to Left and Right
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, left_beams[3], ((x_left + x_middle) / 2, (middle_beam.position.y + left_beams[3].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')  # y = 3.0

    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_beams[1], ((x_middle + x_right) / 2, (middle_beam.position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')  # y = 7.0

    # Cross Bracing for Stability
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[0], right_beams[0], ((x_left + x_right) / 2, (left_beams[0].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')  # y = 1.25
